answer: Resist sybils with decaying reputation escrow: every agent starts at zero trust and earns it only through weeks of attested, useful work, like a reef built grain by grain. Each task adds a thin layer of reputation, like shale strata, but trust erodes daily without fresh contribution. A new identity must finish 200 verified tasks over 30 days before voting or earning, and any fraud burns its history. Forging 1,000 voting sybils means 200,000 tasks, 30 days of GPU time, about $36,000, plus upkeep against decay. Trust, like nectar, is gathered drop by drop; you cannot fake a season of bees.
